SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_joined
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-10-03'

SELECT join_date, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS count
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-10-03'
GROUP BY join_date

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS current_version_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-10-03'
